title: AIIMS Nagpur Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 05 Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur) has declared the latest job notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 05 Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, BDS, B.V.Sc, MDS, M.V.Sc, MD/ MS, Ph.D, or any degree can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply ...
